INSERT INTO seats (schedule_id, seat_no, grade, price, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{seat.scheduleId}, #{seat.seatNo}, #{seat.grade}, #{seat.price}, #{seat.status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT seat_id, schedule_id, seat_no, grade, price, member_Id, status, updated_at, created_at FROM seats WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY seat_no ASC
SELECT seat_id, schedule_id, seat_no, grade, price, member_Id, status, updated_at, created_at FROM seats WHERE seat_id = #{seatId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE seats SET status = #{status}, member_id = #{memberId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE seat_id = #{seatId}

UPDATE seats AS s INNER JOIN concert_schedules AS cs ON cs.schedule_id = s.schedule_id SET s.status = 'TEMPORARY', s.member_id = #{memberId}, s.updated_at = NOW() WHERE s.seat_id = #{seatId} AND s.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND s.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND cs.concert_date > NOW()
